representations.name: Affine b-fibre chamber
representations.new_information: Retains the exact half-line P=A_b b+C_b>0 over every four-variable base point.
representations.first_test: Compute A_b,C_b,D_b,E_b and classify fibres at A_b=0.

representations.name: Four-variable determinant
representations.new_information: Records the exact obstruction Delta=A_b E_b-D_b C_b relating the P boundary to xi.
representations.first_test: Factor Delta and test its sign beyond the nonnegative orthant.

representations.name: A/D wall arrangement
representations.new_information: Keeps the zero walls of the P and xi slopes instead of erasing them in a resultant.
representations.first_test: Find exact intersections A_b=D_b=0 and their relation to the anchor projection.

representations.name: Boundary-ratio coordinates
representations.new_information: Uses b_P=-C_b/A_b and b_xi=-E_b/D_b to compare the two fibre thresholds directly.
representations.first_test: Express b_xi-b_P as Delta/(A_b D_b) in every sign chamber.

representations.name: Exact semialgebraic roadmap
representations.new_information: Preserves connected-component membership rather than only pointwise polynomial signs.
representations.first_test: Build rational straight or piecewise paths and isolate every zero crossing exactly.

representations.name: Iterated singleton elimination
representations.new_information: Tests whether Delta or its base chamber is affine in c or another orbit variable.
representations.first_test: Compute degrees, coefficients and second resultants after eliminating b then c.

representations.name: Anchor boundary deformation
representations.new_information: Tracks the anchor sheet until the first A_b, P or Delta wall instead of sampling isolated slices.
representations.first_test: Parameterize rays and low-degree planes from (1,1,1,1,1).

representations.name: Transverse edge perturbations
representations.new_information: Restores the three edge directions killed by stabilizer equalization.
representations.first_test: Compute first and second transverse derivatives on the audited anchor slices.

representations.name: Positive-orthant coefficient cone
representations.new_information: Uses the 41 positive determinant coefficients as a certified base cone and records precisely where signs can change.
representations.first_test: Determine the maximal sign orthant on which every determinant monomial is nonnegative.

representations.name: Moving-edge global lift
representations.new_information: Retains the graph-level induction interface required by the public problem.
representations.first_test: State the exact transverse/fixed-space lemma sufficient for the inherited moving-edge argument.
